title.en: Volume of a cylindrical storage tank: product of powers, Gauss's formula and Monte Carlo (Possolo & Meija 2022)
title.tr: Silindirik depolama tankının hacmi: kuvvetler çarpımı, Gauss formülü ve Monte Carlo (Possolo & Meija 2022)

description.en: V = πR²H with R = 8.40(3) m and H = 32.50(7) m.

explanation.en: For a product of powers the relative variances add with the squares of the exponents: (u(V)/V)² = (2 × 0.03/8.40)² + (0.07/32.50)², so u(V) = 53.7 m³ ≈ 54 m³ with V = 7204 m³.
explanation.tr: Kuvvetler çarpımında bağıl varyanslar üslerin kareleriyle toplanır: (u(V)/V)² = (2 × 0,03/8,40)² + (0,07/32,50)²; V = 7204 m³ ile u(V) = 53,7 m³ ≈ 54 m³.

explanation.en: The Monte Carlo method with 10⁶ draws gives 7204 m³ give or take 54 m³ and a distribution indistinguishable from a Gaussian one.
explanation.tr: 10⁶ çekilişli Monte Carlo yöntemi 7204 m³ ± 54 m³ ve normalden ayırt edilemeyen bir dağılım verir.

sources.document: Possolo & Meija, Measurement Uncertainty: A Reintroduction, 2nd ed., SIM, Montevideo (2022)
sources.section: Sums, Products, and Ratios: Storage Tank, pp. 18–24
